title: Wendy’s Orange Cream Frosty Recipe
description: Looking for a refreshing treat to beat the summer heat? Look no further than Wendy’s Orange Cream Frosty . This delicious recipe combines the tangy sweetness of oranges with the creamy coolness of vanilla ice cream to create a perfectly balanced dessert that’s sure to satisfy your cravings. And the best part? It’s easy to make right at home! No need to spend a fortune at a fancy ice cream shop – just follow our step-by-step guide and you’ll be enjoying this tasty treat in no time.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
instructions:
• In a blender, combine milk, sugar, corn syrup, cream, and non-fat milk.
  • Blend the mixture on high speed until smooth and well combined.
  • Add thickeners and coloring additives to enhance the visual appeal of the frosty.
  • Blend again until the desired consistency is achieved.
  • Pour the mixture into a chilled glass or bowl.
  • Serve immediately for a delicious and refreshing experience.
notes:
• Experiment with different thickeners to adjust the texture of the frosty to your liking.
    • For a dairy-free option, substitute milk and cream with plant-based alternatives.
    • Customize the flavor by adding orange extract or zest for an extra citrusy kick.
